verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for an equity-management SaaS platform, but the evidence never mentions an AI assistant, chat agent, or task delegation to AI. The documented automations (smart-linking, an automatic data room, generative workflows, Gusto sync) are rule-based workflow features and only adjacent to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
